audience: teams that track working hours, project time and absences in timr

useCases.title: Review working times and breaks in a date range
useCases.text: List working times with their breaks and durations, then open one entry. Start and end locations are not returned.

useCases.title: Check the project time booked on tasks
useCases.text: List the tasks, then list the project times booked on them, with their billable flags.

useCases.title: Book project time for an employee
useCases.text: Find the user, then create a project time on a task. Use a start time with a UTC offset, such as 2026-11-25T08:00:00+01:00.

useCases.title: Correct a working time or a project time
useCases.text: Update the start, end, type, status or notes of a working time, or the task and billable flag of a project time.

useCases.title: Review public holidays in a calendar
useCases.text: List the holiday calendars, then list the public holidays of one calendar, sorted by date.

useCases.title: Sync deleted working times
useCases.text: List the working times deleted since a date-time, so another system can remove them too.
